EDGE_PERF.scope: Edge process. Contributes durations only, never instants.

UE_PERF.scope: The single UE client process. The CARLA route/sensor adapter and the live split dispatch run in that one process, so all UE_PERF readings are mutually comparable.
UE_PERF.warning: Not comparable with WALL_HOST. Any stage needing a UE_PERF instant against an edge WALL_HOST instant is reported unavailable, never estimated.

WALL_HOST.scope: One physical host. The UE CARLA client, the edge Docker container (OAI CN5G bridge network 192.168.70.0/24) and the map process all read the same kernel clock, so these timestamps are mutually comparable.

distribution_fields.median: nearest-rank p50, identical convention to the campaign runner
distribution_fields.negative_residual_count: residual stages only: samples below zero

scientific_rules_enforced: pre-front sensor preparation is never called front_ms
sensor wait is never folded into network transport
no one-way transport is inferred across non-comparable clocks
the 500 ms ACK timeout is never treated as the 100 ms service target
within_100ms and within_500ms are reported separately
per-frame component medians are not expected to sum to the median end-to-end latency
derived residuals are labelled as residuals and carry a negative-residual count

analytic_model_front_transport_back_feed.note: The user's model_front + feature_transport + model_back + compact_feedback quantity, computed only from same-frame compatible timestamps. Explicitly NOT capture-to-install latency: it omits sensor preparation, the prepared-queue wait and UE dispatch overhead, and its transport term is a round-trip residual.

s10_ue_result_receipt_to_map_installatio.note: Stands in for publication->installation because publication has no own timestamp. feature_received_at is the UE's receipt of the compact edge result, not a feature arrival at the edge.

s11_feedback_emit_to_ue_receipt_ms.note: feedback_emit_at is blank on TIMEOUT_NO_ACK rows.

s12_ue_send_to_compact_result_receipt_ms.note: A ROUND TRIP measured entirely inside the UE process. This is the compact result datagram, not the map-install ACK; the ACK leg is s14.

s13_capture_to_install_aoi_ms.note: The registered end-to-end AoI, install_aoi_ms. Defined only for frames that reached MAP_INSTALLED. Recomputed here and checked against the campaign's registered median/p95.

s14_capture_to_ue_feedback_aoi_ms.note: Includes TIMEOUT_NO_ACK rows, whose receipt time is the 500 ms timeout sweep instant rather than a remote ACK.

s1_pre_front_compute_ms.end_event: scene snapshot complete, immediately before UE dispatch
s1_pre_front_compute_ms.note: SUPERSET spanning radar window+prepare, rgb convert, scene snapshot and unattributed remainder. Not a sum of its components.

s1_radar_prepare_ms.note: Radar rasterisation; the dominant pre-front cost.

s1_scene_snapshot_ms.note: Offline-evaluation scene freeze, on the preparation path.

s1_sensor_wait_ms.note: Pure sensor-window availability wait. Pre-front; not transport, not front_ms.
s1_sensor_wait_ms.start_event: prepared-queue worker picks the frame up (process_started_perf)

s2_derived_true_queue_wait_ms_RESIDUAL.end_event: prepared-queue worker picks the frame up
s2_derived_true_queue_wait_ms_RESIDUAL.note: queue_wait_ms minus the same-frame, same-clock preparation components. Small negatives are possible from unattributed gaps; the negative count is reported.
s2_derived_true_queue_wait_ms_RESIDUAL.start_event: frame scheduled onto the prepared queue

s2_queue_depth_at_dispatch.note: Structural queue-occupancy indicator recorded at dispatch.

s2_recorded_queue_wait_ms_ENCLOSES_SENSO.end_event: immediately before the scene snapshot / UE dispatch
s2_recorded_queue_wait_ms_ENCLOSES_SENSO.note: Despite the name this ENCLOSES the sensor wait and radar/RGB preparation. It is NOT a pure prepared-queue wait.
s2_recorded_queue_wait_ms_ENCLOSES_SENSO.start_event: frame scheduled onto the prepared queue (scheduled_perf)

s3_front_backbone_ms.note: The actual model front. This, not front_ms, is the front cost.

s3_front_ms_FULL_UE_DISPATCH_SPAN.end_event: ue_prepare_finished_ns (encode complete, before the first datagram)
s3_front_ms_FULL_UE_DISPATCH_SPAN.note: SUPERSET of total_ue_preparation: also covers 7-channel input assembly, frame-context construction and payload chunking. It contains NO sensor preparation and NO network transport.
s3_front_ms_FULL_UE_DISPATCH_SPAN.start_event: capture_started_ns (UE dispatch entry, after sensor preparation)

s3_total_ue_preparation_ms.note: Instrumented UE preparation total; the model_front term of the user's analytical quantity.

s3_zstd_compression_ms.note: The deployed entropy codec is zstd (lossless).

s4_datagram_send_loop_ms.note: Host-side sendto loop over all chunks. Socket handoff only; not a propagation or radio latency.

s4_derived_ue_uninstrumented_span_ms.note: front_ms minus total_ue_preparation: input assembly, context build and chunking not covered by the instrumented timers.

s5_capture_to_edge_receipt_ms_INCLUDES_S.note: Both boundaries are WALL_HOST so this is measured, but it INCLUDES sensor preparation and the whole UE front. It is not an uplink transport latency.

s5_derived_roundtrip_residual_ms_RESIDUA.note: ROUND TRIP residual = feature uplink + edge queue + compact result downlink. Subtracting a same-frame EDGE_PERF duration from a UE_PERF interval is clock-safe. NOT one-way uplink.

s5_feature_uplink_one_way_ms.note: The two boundaries live in non-comparable clock domains and no simultaneous cross-clock reading is registered, so one-way uplink latency is not computed.

s6_derived_edge_queue_wait_ms_RESIDUAL.note: Edge wall span minus the same-frame instrumented edge processing duration. Both are edge-local, so the subtraction is clock-safe.

s6_edge_receipt_to_tail_complete_ms.note: Edge-internal span: queue wait + decode + tail inference.

s8_frozen_tail_ms.note: The model_back term of the user's analytical quantity.

s9_tail_complete_to_map_publication_ms.note: Map publication is registered only as the categorical map_publication_status; no publication timestamp exists, so this boundary has no end event.

s9_tail_complete_to_ue_result_receipt_ms.note: Compact result downlink leg plus edge post-tail work.
